settings.heading: What we can say about how it is made
settings.text: Only what we can back up. Documents are published here as the client supplies them.

settings.heading: Spring water, ethanol, time
settings.text:
Each tincture is extracted with spring water and approximately 30% food-grade ethanol, then bottled in amber glass with a dropper.

Labels declare the species and a dried-material equivalent per millilitre. That figure is the manufacturer's input ratio, not an assayed potency.

settings.heading: What is verified and what is not
